newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Macronix plans T$3/share dividend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Macronix plans T$3/share dividend.

text.p: Macronix International Corp, one of Taiwan's leading semiconductor makers, said on Thursday it has proposed a stock dividend, or bonus issue, of T$3 per share for 1996.

Its board meeting has set a 1997 net profit target of T$3.1 billion on sales of T$14.3 billion, compared with the actual 1996 net profit of T$3.36 billion on sales of T$10.194 billion, the company said in a statement.
The proposals need approval by its shareholders in a meeting slated for May 31, it said.
